name: active
label: Active
description: If true, sets the button to have an active state

name: iconStart
label: Icon left of label
description: Displays an icon at the start of the button

name: iconEnd
label: Icon right of label
description: Displays an icon at the end of the button

name: animatedIconStart
label: Animated icon left of label
description: Displays an animated icon at the start of the button

name: animatedIconEnd
label: Animated icon right of label
description: Displays an animated icon at the end of the button

name: hideBlockPadding
label: Hide block padding
description: By default, the button's height is based on the size. Select to reduce the button height. This sets the button height to the size of the text. Buttons with this property do not align vertically with other button types

name: showInlinePadding
label: Show inline padding
description: By default, a bare button's width is based on the button's content. Set this to add inline padding either side of the button's content

name: configAria
label: ARIA properties
description: ARIA properties that are set on the inner html. See https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#button for properties and accepted values

name: highContrast
label: High contrast
description: Increases the accessibility contrast ratio of the icon and label when displayed on darker backgrounds

name: landmark
label: Landmark
description: Allow the Landmark Focus keyboard shortcut to focus this button
